Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #2, then do ONLY Part 2.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(shared): add event data types and RewindEvent union (#2)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Add the data type for every event listed in Steps 2 of the issue and combine them into the `RewindEvent` discriminated union.

- All 12 event types from the issue exist
- `RewindEvent` narrows on `event.type`
- No `any`

- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Type tests prove narrowing for at least `mutation`, `network`, `input`

Implementation commit message: `feat(shared): add event data types and RewindEvent union (#2)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`

Push to the existing branch `day-02/session-format`. Do not open a new PR. Do not change earlier parts unless needed to pass checks; say why if you do.
